column1: To require edit similarity of at least 80, use WHERE EDIT_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY(@a, @b) {{c1::>=}} 80.
column2:
This normalized similarity increases as strings become closer.

column1: For closest-first results, sort a score from EDIT_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY using ORDER BY Score {{c1::DESC}}.
column2:

column1: JARO_WINKLER_DISTANCE uses a scale from {{c1::0 to 1}}.
column2:
